mapper.select: select mord.opinion, mord.topic, relation_label as relationLabel, mord.create_time as createTime, opinion_id as opinionId, label_type as labelType, mord.client_id as clientId, mord.channel_id as channelId from mod_opinion_relation_data mord where to_date(mord.create_time) BETWEEN to_date(#{startTime}) and to_date(now())
